center: Price of fresh fruit, vegetables, dairy, and eggs
edges: The drought in California has the potential to impact the price we pay for fresh fruit, vegetables, dairy, and eggs.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The effect of the California drought on food prices is uncertain this year.
The historic California drought has negative effects on other regions of the United States.
Taking a holiday in California will reveal changes due to the drought.
The cost of transporting food from California to the other 49 states is affected by oil prices.
